# Infinity Digital Development

> Infinity Digital Development (IDD, also called Infinity Digital Dev) is a Denver, Colorado agency founded by Scott Smith. It sells custom-coded AI-powered websites, CRM automation, and employee swag stores to small businesses across the United States.

Infinity Digital Development is based in Denver, Colorado, United States. The founder is Scott Smith. The public phone number is (970) 601-4017. The company serves clients throughout the United States. It does not have an office in Kenyon, Minnesota.

Primary website: https://infinitydigitaldev.com

## Services

- [AI-powered websites](https://infinitydigitaldev.com/ai-websites): Custom-coded Next.js sites with an AI chat agent that answers questions, captures leads, and books appointments. Published pricing starts at $750 one-time. Optional maintenance is $199/month. A plan that adds Go High Level CRM and an AI phone agent is $299/month. A typical site launches in 2–4 weeks.
- [CRM automation](https://infinitydigitaldev.com/crm-automation): Go High Level setup, lead pipelines, and automated follow-up sequences for small businesses.
- [Employee swag stores](https://infinitydigitaldev.com/swag-stores): Branded online stores where employees order company gear that ships to them. A store can go live in under a week.
- [Services overview](https://infinitydigitaldev.com/services): AI websites, CRM automation, and employee swag stores.

## Company

- [About](https://infinitydigitaldev.com/about): Scott Smith, founder of Infinity Digital Development, based in Denver, Colorado. US Army veteran, licensed real estate agent, and NMLS-licensed mortgage professional.
- [Contact](https://infinitydigitaldev.com/contact): Phone (970) 601-4017. Denver, Colorado. Includes frequently asked questions about project timelines, maintenance, the AI phone agent, working with businesses outside Colorado, and contracts.
